fixme.missing: _expand_dirs expands a writes_to directory to `git diff --name-only <anchor> HEAD -- <dir>`, which includes files OTHER tickets changed after the anchor. Measured 2026-10-02 on efb670ff1dd8's hollow (HEAD f670e2fb, anchor 1923f254): ground_loop/__main__.py and cli.py (59ade57ef280, 89bfb8fb), discovery.py (the 09-30 restatement, 507a15ad) and intention+why.json (56d1aff4455e and others) read HOLLOW although no efb670ff1dd8 commit touched them — the proof blamed for another hand's edit (Law 7). A directory must expand only to the files the ticket's own build commits (those naming the ticket id after the anchor) changed under it; tooth 2's fixture gains an unrelated commit after the build that the reading must not measure.

_revert removes a file absent at the anchor but leaves its parent directories, now empty, in the worktree. Measured 2026-10-02 on efb670ff1dd8: reverting ground_loop/probes/__init__.py (added by c2d2fedf) left an empty probes/ folder, discovery still registered ground_loop by that folder, and tooth 3 stayed green — so the file read HOLLOW. With the empty folder removed as well, tooth 3 reds (LookupError: no shim answers to 'ground_loop'), measured in a scratch worktree at HEAD f670e2fb. The counterfactual of 'the build had not happened' is a clean checkout of the anchor, which has no empty directory.
